title: Log silent JSON unmarshal failures in core data stores
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**Files** (6 locations):
- `core/context/engine/service.go:70` — BuildWindow() silently skips corrupt history events
- `core/context/engine/service.go:216` — LoadChunks() silently skips corrupt chunk records
- `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:103-104` — List() silently skips corrupt DLQ entries
- `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:149` — ListByScore() silently skips corrupt entries
- `core/infra/memory/job_store.go:1211` — ListSafetyDecisions() silently skips corrupt records
- `core/workflow/store_redis.go:150` — ListWorkflows() silently skips corrupt workflow data

**Pattern**:
```go
if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &obj); err == nil {
    // use obj
}
// Silent skip if error — no logging, no indication data was dropped
```

**Fix**: Add `slog.Warn` logging when unmarshal fails so corrupted data is detectable. Include the key/ID of the record that failed.
definitionOfDone: All 6 locations log a warning on unmarshal failure
Log includes record key/ID and error message
Corrupted data is detectable in logs

implementationPlan.description:
At all 6 locations, change the silent `continue` after `json.Unmarshal` failure to log a warning before continuing. The pattern:
```go
if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &obj); err != nil {
    slog.Warn("<store>: corrupt record skipped", "key", <key/id>, "error", err)
    continue
}
```

Specific locations:
1. `core/context/engine/service.go:70` — BuildWindow, log event key
2. `core/context/engine/service.go:216` — LoadChunks, log chunk key
3. `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:103` — List, log DLQ member ID
4. `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:149` — ListByScore, log DLQ member ID
5. `core/infra/memory/job_store.go:1211` — ListSafetyDecisions, log job ID
6. `core/workflow/store_redis.go:150` — ListWorkflows, log workflow ID
Ensure `log/slog` is imported in each file (add if needed).
Run `go test ./core/...` to verify no regressions.

reopenReason: DoD item "Corrupted data is detectable in logs" needs a test proving the slog.Warn fires on corrupt input. Add a unit test to at least one location (e.g. context engine BuildWindow) that feeds invalid JSON and asserts the warning is logged via a slog handler spy.
